node.title: XR low-core one-loop deficiency reduces to the coherent GRS split-pencil census
node.statement: In the P-B rank-five (u,v)=(0,1) branch, the loop coordinate is an agreement for at most one slope. Removing it and that possible exceptional member from a family above B=8n^3 leaves at least B regular members in a GRS_4 extension, with agreement block sizes 10/10/8 and pair cap four. Peeling at budget B-1 forces r=2 collision-direction degrees 209/207/66; every retained block is a divided-difference monochromatic clique, its reused directions are hypersurface-free through degrees 5/5/3, and optimized local zero-minor floors are 97650/52530/1782. This reduces the deficiency pair to a coherent split-pencil census but does not count it.
